question: The Third Battle of Panipat took place in ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1761.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Third Battle of Panipat took place on January 14, 1761, between the Marathas and the Afghan invader Ahmad Shah Durrani.
 
• The battle was fought near the city of Panipat, which is now in the Indian state of Haryana.
 
• The Marathas were led by Sadashivrao Bhau, who was supported by other prominent leaders like Vishwasrao, the son of Peshwa Baji Rao I, and Ibrahim Khan Gardi.
 
• **The Afghan forces were led by Ahmad Shah Durrani, who had a well-trained and well-equipped army of around 100,000 soldiers.**
 
• The Third Battle of Panipat was one of the largest and bloodiest battles fought in the 18th century, and it resulted in a decisive victory for the Afghan forces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The year 1757 is significant in Indian history as it marks the Battle of Plassey, which was fought between the East India Company and Siraj-ud-Daulah, the Nawab of Bengal.**
